mostWorthwhile.text: The calcium-triggered pulling cycle was most worthwhile: the planned illustration distinguishes sliding filaments from shortening filaments and shows ATP's role in the cycle.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling the triceps repeated the biceps force-transfer inset, so that passage added less than the earlier assembly.

surprise.text: Relaxation also requires ATP to pump calcium back into storage, and the fibre lengthens under an outside pull.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though most early combinations were the only offered option rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: Yes. The progression from filament movement to opposing muscle actions makes me curious how the next chapter connects structures to function.
